label: manifold-copper-40lpm-fine

decision.note: Report sweep point 40 L/min (report local channel speeds 11.9/14.9/19.9 m/s ~ 24/30/40 L/min total).

notes: Mesh-sensitivity pair to manifold-copper-40lpm (run 20260918T230613, 2.83 bar, 154.4 C): the channel refinement box goes from 0.2 mm to 0.15 mm (about 7 cells across the 1 mm gap instead of 5) and is extended over the 1.6 mm high header slots (|x| 26-34 mm, y 0.6-2.4 mm) where the flow turns into the 17 channels. Parallel HXT mesher with the quality gate (7.6 M cells, min SICN 0.10). Earlier attempts: 0.12 mm with the serial mesher (run 20260921T194324) failed checkMesh on sliver cells; on this mesh the potential-flow start spiked to 166 m/s and -2000 bar at the channel-mouth corners and tet-robust produced a negative fluid temperature at iteration 450 (case-0ba8adbb), lower relaxation diverged faster (case-3dbd6604). Stage 1 (this spec): the converged 0.2 mm solution is mapped onto this mesh (initialization.fields_mapped_from_case) and tet-robust continues to 1500 iterations. Stage 2: manifold-copper-40lpm-fine-restart.json with tet-robust-restart removes the limited-gradient floor on the solid residual. Same copper, constant transport, 20 C in, 8 bar out, 10 MW/m2 as the report replication.
